signals.title: Heavy rain and landslide risk, central Veracruz
signals.description: Late rainy season: saturated slopes on the Orizaba–Puebla stretch of MEX-150D. Trucks queue at partial closures and transit from Orizaba stretches from 2 to about 5 days.

signals.title: Hurricane watch, Gulf of Mexico coast
signals.description: A tropical system is forecast to approach the Veracruz coast; heavy rain inland on 8–12 Oct. A watch, not a warning.
signals.source: SMN tropical cyclone bulletin (seeded for demo)

signals.title: Road closure, MEX-57D near Palmillas
signals.description: Lane closure for bridge repair; trucks are diverted for a few hours at a time.
signals.source: Capufe / SCT road report (seeded for demo)

signals.short: Highway blockade near Puebla and Tlaxcala
signals.title: Highway blockade, Puebla–Tlaxcala corridor
signals.description: Community blockade on MEX-119 and MEX-190 near Amozoc. Cargo is held or rerouted through side roads.
signals.source: Local news and carrier reports (seeded for demo)

signals.short: Night cargo theft on MEX-45D / MEX-57D
signals.title: Cargo theft hotspot, MEX-45D / MEX-57D at night
signals.description: Reported hijackings on the Celaya–Querétaro and Querétaro–San Luis Potosí stretches between 20:00 and 05:00. Carriers add escorts or hold trucks until daylight.

signals.title: Container congestion, Port of Manzanillo
signals.description: Yard saturation and customs queues delay container release by 3–5 days; imported resin reaches the supplier late and outbound loads slip.
signals.source: API Manzanillo terminal notice (seeded for demo)

signals.short: Press 4 unplanned stop at Estampados del Laja
signals.title: Press 4 breakdown, Estampados del Laja
signals.description: Die change overran on Press 4 (400 t). Output is being recovered with overtime; outbound shipments leave later in the day, and more of them at night.

signals.short: Heavy rain in the Toluca valley
signals.title: Heavy afternoon rain, Toluca valley
signals.description: Daily storms flood low-lying roads around Toluca and slow trucks on MEX-15D.

alerts.title: Transit from Orizaba goes from 2 to 5 days
alerts.message: QRO Seating Systems holds 3 days of cover of lumbar air line, 6 mm hose assembly (QSS-6120-LMB). With transit at 5 days (up to 8.3 in the worst case) and nothing done, cover runs out in about 2 days, around 7 Oct 2026.

actions.label: Pull the next order forward
actions.description: Ask Hules y Mangueras de Orizaba to ship the next two orders before the rain peaks, adding about 1.5 days of cover.

actions.label: Add 2 days of safety stock
actions.description: Raise the lumbar air line safety stock to 5 days until the rainy season ends (about MX$38k of inventory).

actions.label: Use the alternative route via Tehuacán
actions.description: Route trucks through Tehuacán and Cuacnopalan (MEX-150 free road) to avoid the landslide-prone Orizaba–Puebla toll stretch.

alerts.title: Highway blockade, Puebla–Tlaxcala corridor
alerts.message: QRO Seating Systems holds 1.5 days of cover of seat side trim cover (QSS-7205-TRM). Transit is 1.1 days against 1 planned (up to 2.8 in the worst case). Without action, projected cover falls to 0.2 days around 6 Oct 2026; no stop is expected in the next 14 days, but a bad week could stop the line.

actions.label: Pull the next order forward
actions.description: Ask Plásticos Inyectados de Puebla to ship one day early, before the blockade peaks.

actions.label: Use the alternative route via MEX-150D
actions.description: Reroute through MEX-150D toll road, bypassing the Amozoc–Tlaxcala corridor.

actions.label: Add 2 days of safety stock
actions.description: Build 2 days of cover on the seat side trim cover; it is single-source and a line-stopper.

alerts.title: Road closure, MEX-57D near Palmillas
alerts.message: QRO Seating Systems holds 1.5 days of cover of m6 flange screw, zinc-nickel (QSS-9011-FLS). Transit is 2.1 days against 2 planned (up to 3.5 in the worst case). Without action, projected cover falls to 0.7 days around 5 Oct 2026; no stop is expected in the next 14 days, but a bad week could stop the line.

actions.label: Pull the next order forward
actions.description: Ask Tornillos y Sujetadores to ship Thursday's flange screw order on Tuesday.

actions.label: Add 3 days of safety stock
actions.description: Buy a one-off buffer of M6 flange screws; at MX$0.62 each this is under MX$30k for 3 days.

actions.label: Qualify the second source
actions.description: Flange screws are single-source. Qualify a second heading shop in the Bajío.

alerts.title: Transit from Manzanillo goes from 2 to 3 days
alerts.message: QRO Seating Systems holds 2 days of cover of pa6 glass-filled resin, seat base compound (QSS-5310-PAB). Transit is 3 days against 2 planned (up to 3.8 in the worst case). Without action, projected cover falls to 1 days around 5 Oct 2026; no stop is expected in the next 14 days, but a bad week could stop the line.

actions.label: Ask for resin on hand
actions.description: Ask Resinas del Pacífico to confirm how many days of PA6 compound it has outside the port.

actions.label: Add 3 days of safety stock
actions.description: Raise PA6 compound stock at QSS to 6 days while the port clears.

actions.label: Qualify the second source
actions.description: Qualify a domestic PA6 compound source so a port delay does not reach the line.

alerts.title: Press 4 breakdown, Estampados del Laja
alerts.message: QRO Seating Systems holds 1.2 days of cover of recliner mounting plate (QSS-4480-RCP). Transit is 1.4 days against 1 planned (up to 1.9 in the worst case). Without action, projected cover falls to 0.8 days around 5 Oct 2026; no stop is expected in the next 14 days, but a bad week could stop the line.

actions.label: Ask for a confirmed ship plan
actions.description: Ask Estampados del Laja for a daily ship plan until Press 4 is stable.

actions.label: Move departures to daytime
actions.description: Agree that loads for QSS leave between 06:00 and 18:00 to avoid the MEX-45D night theft risk.

actions.label: Add 2 days of safety stock
actions.description: Hold 2 extra days of the recliner mounting plate while Press 4 recovers.

supplierResponse.message: Press 4 is back in production since Monday night. We confirm capacity for the next two QSS orders and will add a Saturday shift if the +15% arrives. Departures for QSS will leave before 18:00.
